examples.title: Converting to Seconds
examples.problem: How many seconds are in 3 minutes 20 seconds?
examples.explanation: Always convert the larger unit to the smaller unit by multiplying by 60.

examples.title: Journey Time
examples.problem: A bus leaves at 8:45 AM and arrives at 11:15 AM. How long is the journey?
examples.solution: 8:45 to 10:45 is 2 hours. 10:45 to 11:15 is 30 minutes. Total: 2 hours 30 minutes.
examples.explanation: Count full hours first, then add remaining minutes.

examples.title: Adding Durations
examples.explanation: Since 60 minutes make an hour, we subtract 60 from 70 and carry over 1 to the hours place.
